_about: Curriculum: can PPO learn to bomb when it first trains against harmless opponents? One run per seed trains the same model against idle bots (they always WAIT: crates, kills and the gate win can be learned safely), then noisy25, noisy10 and rule bots, each stage for a fixed number of steps. Rewards and entropy bonus of E2's shaped_explore. 5 seeds, each judged by the final evaluation protocol (all 5 levels, 200 games each). Run with: python -m rl.run_ppo_seeds experiments/ppo/curriculum.json (keys starting with _ are comments).
name: curriculum
_parallel: 1: the long runs train on the GPU, one run at a time.

config._total_timesteps: SET ME: the steps per seed. Must equal the sum of the four stages' timesteps (the plan refuses otherwise). The plan refuses to start while this is null.
config._eval_every: SET ME: the evaluation interval, from the benchmark (conclusion.smallest_eval_every_for_5_percent or larger).
config._device_vec_env_torch_threads: SET FROM THE BENCHMARK: device (cpu or cuda), vec_env (dummy or subproc) and torch_threads for one run at a time.

_variants: One variant: v0 plus E2's shaped_explore (wait = -0.002 per WAIT or refused BOMB; bomb_survived = 0.05 per own bomb that exploded and broke at least one crate while the agent is alive; ent_coef 0.05, v0: 0.01) and the four curriculum stages. opponents must equal the first stage's opponents (idle).

curriculum._eval_opponents: SET ME: the ladder level of the evaluation during training (never idle; random would match E2's learning curves). A run with stages must set it.
curriculum._stages: SET ME: the timesteps of each stage, the same for every seed. Each must be a positive whole number of rollouts (n_envs x n_steps = 8 x 256 = 2,048 steps), and together they must equal total_timesteps. Stage k's envs are seeded with seed + k x n_envs; every stage but the last ends with checkpoints/stage<k>_<opponents>_<step>.zip.
